arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo "SUPERVISOR_VPS_CONFIG_PROBE"
sudo -n python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('/root/project-secrets')
matches=[]
if root.is_dir():
 for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
  if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():continue
  rel=str(p.relative_to(root))
  if len(p.parts)>len(root.parts)+4:continue
  if not any(x in rel.lower() for x in ('supervisor','project-leader','project_leader','codex','telegram-notif','github')):continue
  try:
   if p.stat().st_size>100000:continue
   txt=p.read_text(encoding='utf8',errors='ignore')
   flags={k:bool(re.search(r'(?m)^\s*(?:export\s+)?'+k+r'\s*=\s*\S+',txt)) for k in ('GH_TOKEN','GITHUB_TOKEN','TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN','TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID')}
   matches.append((rel,flags))
  except (OSError,PermissionError):
   pass
print("CANDIDATE_FILES=%d"%len(matches))
for rel,flags in matches[:35]:
 print("CANDIDATE=%s FLAGS=%s"%(rel,','.join(k for k,v in flags.items() if v) or 'none'))
print("DEDICATED_SUPERVISOR_CREDENTIAL_PAIR=%s"%("YES" if any(v.get('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN') and v.get('TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID') for _,v in matches) else "NO"))
print("GITHUB_READ_CREDENTIAL=%s"%("YES" if any(v.get('GH_TOKEN') or v.get('GITHUB_TOKEN') for _,v in matches) else "NO"))
PY
echo "SUPERVISOR_EXISTING_UNITS"
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager --no-legend | grep -Ei 'project-leader|supervisor|codex' || :
echo "CONFIG_PROBE_FINISHED"
